concerns.text: The plan cites the **Recount3 Human Brain Subset (GTEx brain samples)** (https://huggingface.co/datasets/jarrydmartinx/recount3-RNA-seq/…) as the primary expression matrix. Recount3 provides bulk RNA‑seq data, not single‑cell RNA‑seq. All downstream analyses (GRNBoost2 per developmental window, Harmony batch correction on cells, HVG selection, motif‑validated GRNs, rewiring detection) require single‑cell resolution. Using a bulk dataset makes the proposed GRN inference and rewiring methodology infeasible and invalid for the research question.
